title: UltraFairLoot+
description: UltraFairLoot+ | [1.20.6+] | Advanced Custom Loot Tables, Individual Drops, Damage Split, Custom Rewards
body:
# **UltraFairLoot+**
The ultimate solution for fair, exciting, and spectacular mob loot.​
Reward Every player for their contribution with custom loot tables.​


## Mind-Blowing Features​

**✨ Two Powerful Loot Systems ✨**
Choose your server's philosophy with a single line in the config!​
- **Individual Rolls**: Every player gets their own lottery ticket. They each get a separate, personal roll on the entire loot table.
- **Proportional Split**: One master loot pool is generated and split fairly among all contributors based on the percentage of damage they dealt.

**Four Unique Delivery Modes**
Control exactly how players receive their rewards.​
- **Chest Mode**: The ultimate experience. A spectacular, personal loot chest falls from the sky for each player, complete with beams, holograms, and sounds.
- **GUI Mode**: A clean, modern pop-up menu where players can view and claim their rewards.
- **Inventory Mode**: For a fast-paced experience, loot is added directly to the player's inventory.
- **Drop Mode**: A classic feel where loot is dropped on the ground at the player's feet.

**⚙️ Infinitely Customizable ⚙️**
You have total control.​
- **Advanced Loot Tables**: Create loot with custom items (names, lore, enchants, models), run commands, give money (Vault support!), or grant XP.
- **Stunning Visual & Audio Effects**: Design your own effects in a simple 'effects.yml' library. Control sounds, particles, loot beams, and custom, dependency-free holograms!
- **Persistent & Polished**: Loot chests are saved through server restarts! All systems are designed to be exploit-free and performance-friendly.
